topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Stepping into the studio, the rain pausing in a rare truce with the sky, I saw the artist, a whirl of emotions, fingering the flyer with more than just a touch of disbelief. "Someone's been copying my work," she muttered, eyes narrowing, "on skin, no less." I could see the challenge lighting her up, the spark of something more than just anger. "People do crazy things these days," I said, my voice light, leaning against the doorway, a half-smile playing on my lips. "But let's track this down. Might find out they've got a softer spot for your art than you think." The room seemed a bit brighter, the shadows retreating. We had a case, and it felt good.
